text: SAMPLE COLLEGE ADVISORY 20 September 2030 Please be informed that the Midterm Examinations for the 1st Semester of AY 2030-2031 are scheduled on September 28-30, 2030. Students are advised to secure their examination permits from the Finance Office before the examination week. Please bring your Certificate of Registration (COR) when making your payment.

SAMPLE DYCI ADVISORY 27 September 2030 SHORTENED CLASS HOURS Please be informed that tomorrow, September 28, 2030, classes at all levels and office operations will be until 1:00 PM only, in observance of National Family Week. Regular operations will resume on the next working day.

SAMPLE URGENT: CAPSTONE DEFENSE SCHEDULE Please be informed that the semi-final capstone defense will be held on October 3, 2030 at 8:00 AM in the AVR. Groups must submit three printed copies of their manuscript to the Research Office by October 1, 2030.
SAMPLE 100 DAYS OF KINDNESS, DAY 18. Our student council shared bread and juice with the security and maintenance staff this morning. Thank you for keeping our campus safe and clean every day!

SAMPLE DYCI ADVISORY 10 September 2030 To all DYCIans, in-person classes at all levels are suspended tomorrow, September 11, 2030, due to continuous heavy rainfall. Classes shall shift to online learning. Please stay safe, DYCIans!
